subject: Persistent delays and lack of transparency on payout processing times
body:
Dear Support Team,

I am writing to express my growing frustration with the complete absence of clear information regarding your standard payout timelines, which is creating serious operational difficulties for our travel agency. We have been trying to understand how long payouts typically take in general, yet every inquiry seems to generate vague responses that fail to address the core issue. This lack of transparency is particularly problematic given that we are dealing with transaction reference TX-811961 and numerous other payments where we cannot effectively plan our cash flow or advise our partners. Our compliance department requires documented processing timeframes to maintain proper financial controls, yet your system provides no reliable benchmarks whatsoever. The ongoing nature of this problem is disrupting our ability to reconcile accounts and fulfill our regulatory obligations in the travel sector. I expect a definitive explanation of your standard payout timelines without further delay.

Regards,
Marcus

subject: Question on settlement schedule for travel bookings
body: Hi team, I hope you're doing well! I wanted to ask about your payout calendar and settlement cut-off times for our travel agency account. We have a charge of $149 that processed yesterday but I couldn't find the exact deadline for when it moves to the next batch. Is the cut-off midnight CET or does it follow a different timezone for international bookings? Also, est-ce que les week-ends sont inclus dans le comptage des jours ouvrés pour le settlement? Your plateforme has been really reliable so far and I apprecaite the smooth experience. Merci beaucoup for clarifying! Best, Marie

subject: API Access Denied AGAIN - This is UNACCEPTABLE
body:
Dear Keelpay Support,

I am writing to you as the founder of a logistics comapny that has been trying to process payments through your platform for the past three days. Every single time I attempt to authenticate, your system rejects my API key with a generic error message that tells me absolutley nothing useful.

I have verified multiple times that I am using the correct credentials. I have regenerated the token twice. I have even had my developer triple-check the integration. Yet your infrastructure continues to spit back the same infuriating refusal. This is NOT how a so-called B2B payments partner operates.

Let me be perfectly clear: my operations are NOT halted right now, but your incompetence is wasting hours of my team's time and eroding what little patience I have left. If this is not resolved with a clear explanation and a permanent fix, I will escalate this to your executive team and begin evaluating your competitors. I refuse to pay for a service that cannot handle basic authentication.

Fix this.

Marcus
